entities.summary: Hans Hedberg was a French sculptor who resided in Biot in southern France until his death. Hedberg was born in Köpmanholmen, Västernorrland County, Sweden. He was mostly known for his gigantic ceramic sculptures of fruit and eggs, and has installations in several countries, especially in his native Sweden and in France.
